description: Get one fillprompt.com prompt picked at random, in full (the same shape as get_prompt), for requests like "surprise me" or "give me an idea for a poster" that have no search query. Narrow it with type, model or category.

category.description: Image category (e.g. "poster") or text prompt type (e.g. "agent"). See list_filters.

model.description: Only prompts written for this AI model, e.g. "Nano Banana", "Seedance", "Claude". See list_filters.

type.description: Only image, video or text prompts.

name: random_prompt
title: Random prompt
